<code><nowiki>{{ItemLink}}</nowiki></code> renders an item icon and page link. On browsers with the default item-tooltips gadget enabled, hovering the link or focusing it with the keyboard opens the tooltip already rendered on the linked item page.

The hover preview is page-based: it reads the tooltip already rendered on the linked item page. The gadget copies the selected item card and its adjacent ability details.

== Usage ==

<pre>{{ItemLink|Cometshard Shield}}</pre>

Use explicit display fields when the visible name, image, or destination differs from the first positional parameter:

<pre>{{ItemLink
 |Cometshard Shield
 |link=Cometshard Shield
 |text=Cometshard Shield
 |image=Cometshard Shield.png
}}</pre>

The link picker may also supply <code>stablekey</code>. This is the exact advanced identity selected for the item by the picker. It distinguishes records that can share a page or display name. Editors normally do not need to memorize or type it. Generated picker output carries the stable key together with explicit <code>link</code>, <code>text</code>, and a nonempty <code>image</code> fallback. When a stable key is supplied, the catalog provides the canonical page, name, and image, while explicit <code>link</code>, <code>text</code>, or <code>image</code> values remain presentation overrides:

<pre>{{ItemLink|stablekey=item:chest - 38 - abyssal plate}}</pre>

To request a released quality variant:

<pre>{{ItemLink|Cometshard Shield|quality=Blessed}}</pre>

The supported qualities are:

* Standard
* Improved +1
* Improved +2
* Improved +3
* Improved +4
* Improved +5
* Blessed
* Ascended

Omitting <code>quality</code> selects the Standard tooltip.

== Hoverable examples ==

Hover or keyboard-focus these examples to see the rendered previews:

{| class="wikitable"
! Example
! Result
|-
| General item
| {{ItemLink|Planar Stone}}
|-
| Equipment
| {{ItemLink|Aevum}}
|-
| Equipment with ability details
| {{ItemLink|Imperium}}
|-
| Specific quality
| {{ItemLink|Aevum|quality=Blessed}}
|}

== How hover previews work ==

The [[MediaWiki:Gadget-item-tooltips.js|item-tooltips gadget]] is enabled by default through [[MediaWiki:Gadgets-definition|the gadget definition]]. <code>ItemLink</code> supplies the destination page and requested quality. The gadget watches those links for pointer hover and keyboard focus.

When activated, the gadget asks the MediaWiki API to render the destination page, selects the requested item card, and copies that card plus any adjacent ability details into a floating preview. The preview does not replace or intercept the original link, which remains the element to click to open the item page.

If the gadget is disabled or JavaScript is unavailable, <code>ItemLink</code> still works as an ordinary page link.

== Parameters ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter
! Description
|-
| <code>1</code>, <code>item</code>, or <code>name</code>
| Item page and default display text. The first positional parameter is the usual form.
|-
| <code>stablekey</code>
| Exact advanced item identity selected by the Erenshor link picker. It is intended for generated or identity-sensitive links, not for values users need to memorize.
|-
| <code>link</code> or <code>page</code>
| Explicit destination page. This is also the page parsed for the hover tooltip.
|-
| <code>text</code>
| Visible link text.
|-
| <code>image</code>
| Item image filename. <code>.png</code> is added when no supported image extension is supplied.
|-
| <code>quality</code>
| Select one of the quality variants listed above. Invalid values produce a template error instead of silently selecting another quality.
|-
| <code>imageonly</code>
| When true, render only the linked image.
|}

== Hover tooltip requirements ==

* The destination page must exist and render an item tooltip. If it does not, the preview says ''Item tooltip unavailable.''
* Equipment pages may contain all eight quality cards. The gadget selects only the requested card and includes its adjacent proc, worn, or activatable ability details when present.
* Items that share one destination page also share that page's hover tooltip.
* The preview itself is non-interactive. Its copied links are disabled. Click the original ItemLink to open the item page.
* Hover activation is suppressed on touch/coarse-pointer devices, where ItemLink remains an ordinary link.
